inputs.name: ollama_version
inputs.description: Ollama release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's sha256sum.txt. Change these with ollama_version.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address and port the Ollama API listens on. The API has no authentication: "0.0.0.0:11434" lets anyone who can reach the host use it.

inputs.name: models
inputs.description: Models to pull from the Ollama library, such as ["llama3.2:3b", "qwen2.5:0.5b"]. A model without a tag gets latest.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Extra environment for the Ollama server, such as { OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE = "30m" }. Set the listen address with listen_address.
